text: Tonight, seven vampires vote on whether I get to live.
And honestly? Hollywood started it.
In every vampire film, she was the hottest one there.
So that became my type. Pale. Black lace. Hates mornings.
Eight years of goth nights. Nothing.
Then, three weeks ago, there she was. Not drinking.
At my door, she asked me to invite her in.
I thought that was flirting.
I opened the wine. The glass broke in my hand.
She said sorry. She said it a lot.
I woke at sunset. My watch couldn't find a pulse.
Under the door, a black envelope. Made without permission. Present yourself.
They have rules. No turning anyone without a vote.
And no one finds out.
Then the eldest slid my phone across the table.
My story from that night. Two glasses. Nobody next to me.
Three hundred people watched it.
She's at the far end. She hasn't looked at me once.
It's three votes each.
The last one is hers.
Sorry.
